description: Start a deployment of version `2.4.1` of the `checkout` service, then check its status immediately and every 10 seconds after that, making at most 6 checks in total, until its state is `succeeded`, `failed`, or `rolled-back`. Return a record with `state` (the last state seen) and `checks` (how many status checks were made). If the deployment is still unfinished after the sixth check, return `state` as `timeout`.

types.DeployStatus: Record {id: String, state: String, progress: Int}

capabilities.description: Starts a deployment of a service version and returns its id.
Reads a deployment's state: pending, running, succeeded, failed, or rolled-back.
